remarks: Perfectly Located Luxury, Unmatched Convenience!  Experience the best of New Canaan living in this luxurious, recently renovated (2023) townhouse, ideally situated IN TOWN!. Enjoy unparalleled convenience with easy strolls to the Metro-North station, local cafes, coffee shops, acclaimed restaurants, shops, and the movie theater-everything is within reach. This end unit townhouse offers ultimate convenience with four dedicated parking spots, including an attached garage and three reserved spaces at your doorstep. Step inside to a stunning 2023 renovation featuring wide-plank white oak floors throughout and a showpiece kitchen with quartz countertops, prestigious Thermador appliances, and a cleverly integrated laundry/pantry. The sun-filled living area, complete with gas fireplace  opens to a private, fenced patio. Upstairs, find two spacious en-suite bedrooms, including a primary suite with a newly renovated bathroom. The finished and expansive lower level offers flexible space for a family room, office, and gym. All core systems are top of the line(Bosch A/C, Weil McLain boiler, Bradford White hot water heater) and brand new from 2023, ensuring total comfort and peace of mind. This isn't just a townhouse; it's a seamless, integrated lifestyle in the heart of town. Welcome home.
